mechanism_hypotheses.title: From field observations to instrumented measurements
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: What is inadequately observed?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What measurement validity and error models apply?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which existing sensor/form systems can capture the signal?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Who pays for measurement reliability, and does it replace an existing workflow?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Repair, refurbishment and circular re-use
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: What assets lose usable value prematurely?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which failure modes and reliability limits determine repairability?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: What diagnosers, parts inventories and repair instructions already exist?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Can recovery cost plus warranty risk undercut replacement?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Matching surplus assets to time-sensitive needs
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Where do goods/services remain unused despite demand?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What inventory, spoilage, scheduling and fairness constraints matter?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which claims/reservation/dispatch systems work?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: What party bears coordination costs and could fund a service?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: From forecast signal to measured resilience outcome
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which communities face losses?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which hazard and outcome relationships are supported?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which alert/response systems are field-deployed and maintained?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Who funds preparedness and is an intervention purchasable?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Field survey integrity and sampling
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Where do missing/duplicated field observations distort decisions?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which sampling and missingness effects matter?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which open form, capture and de-dup systems exist?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Is an auditable data-quality service worth buying?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Operational optimization with real-world constraints
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which decisions waste resources?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What capacity/scheduling/bottleneck constraints explain loss?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which solvers or schedulers solve compatible formulations?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Does a measurable operating-cost saving exceed deployment cost?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Source-to-conclusion auditing
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which decisions lack inspectable justification?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What data lineage and uncertainty are required?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which provenance registries or DAGs already exist?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Who needs independently reproducible conclusions?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Link physical measurement to simulation
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which prototypes lack reliable validation?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: How do models and real measurements differ?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which open solvers and calibration tools can be joined?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Would a calibrated service shorten design cycles?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Materials and chemical compatibility for repair
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: What devices or components fail through material processes?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What compatibility/aging/corrosion mechanisms are relevant?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which repair methods/materials exist and meet safety constraints?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Can compatibility checks lower repair failure rates?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Reproducibility and software acceptance
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which workflows are unreliable or irreproducible?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which statistical/engineering guarantees are needed?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which tests and reproducible pipelines can verify them?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Could an operator pay for validation rather than a new product?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Anomaly discovery to documented investigation
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Where are misleading or anomalous signals costly?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which false-positive/counterevidence mechanisms must be distinguished?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which trace/attribution tools already work?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Would a public-interest actor fund defensible case investigation?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Electricity supply and load resilience
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Where is electricity access/cost/reliability binding?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which grid, storage and conversion constraints apply?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which forecasting, control and electronics projects can be reused?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: What regulated installation and payback evidence is required?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Measure outcomes beyond operational throughput
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which programs report activity without measuring actual benefits?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which causal counterfactual and outcome measures apply?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: What implemented monitoring systems exist?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Can an outcomes audit be funded by implementers or donors?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Private data access with auditable workflows
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Who needs to share sensitive records safely?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What privacy and minimum-data principles apply?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which identity and access-control modules are credible?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Who bears compliance or trust costs?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Moving research into usable production workflows
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which scientific methods remain inaccessible in day-to-day systems?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What are the model assumptions?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which packages and interfaces already exist?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Who needs packaging, support or hosted infrastructure?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Physical engineering to editable electronic designs
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which hardware lacks digital documentation?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: What is observable and reconstructable?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: What OCR, tracing, EDA and 3D tools can interoperate?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Is reconstruction cheaper than redesign or replacement?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Trace claims, propagation and independent verification
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which narratives or reports affect decisions?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: How to separate fact, repetition and correlated sources?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: What archive/claim graph systems exist?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Who values independently checked evidence enough to sponsor it?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Reuse across incompatible engineering subsystems
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: What practical assemblies fail due to interface friction?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which interface constraints and standards govern?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: What adapters, middleware and device bridges exist?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Can interoperability work create service demand?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Public demand versus open-source implementation supply
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which requirements are in funded procurements?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which standards and accessibility laws apply?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which OSS components could satisfy objective acceptance tests?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Can a licensed integrator bid, and are terms viable?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Localized hosting, language and institutional workflows
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Which imported products fail local workflows?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which language, regulation and accessibility constraints matter?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which maintained software is adaptable without violating licenses?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: Will organizations pay for localization and continuing support?

mechanism_hypotheses.title: Engineering arbitrage before commercialization
mechanism_hypotheses.practical_question: Where is a claimed opportunity based on weak or missing cost data?
mechanism_hypotheses.academic_question: Which failures, uncertainty and opportunity costs determine expected payoff?
mechanism_hypotheses.implementation_question: Which available systems make cheap controlled pilots possible?
mechanism_hypotheses.economic_question: What buyer, rights, cost and execution evidence makes conversion viable?
